newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Fourteen people killed in clan clash in Somalia.
newsitem.headline: Fourteen people killed in clan clash in Somalia.

text.p: Fourteen people were killed and 11 wounded in inter-clan fighting over a water well in a village north of Mogadishu, residents said by radio on Friday.
The residents said clansmen fought for four hours on Thursday in the village of Awsweine, 380 km (240 miles) north of Mogadishu.

The village is split between the Murusade and Abgal clans which are loyal to north Mogadishu faction leader Ali Mahdi Mohamed and the interior minister in a south Mogadishu-based "government" appointed by faction leader Hussein Aideed.
Somalia has had no central government and has been divided into fiefdoms controlled by rival militia forces since the overthrow of the late dictator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991.
